program.name: Bell AMRAP
program.subject: Kettlebell complexes
program.blurb: As many rounds as you can of a kettlebell complex, then a second, shorter one.
program.about: As many rounds as you can of a kettlebell complex, then a second, shorter one after a breather. The first AMRAP is the long one, five moves without putting the bell down; the second is a quicker chain to finish. Write your rounds down and try to beat them two weeks later. Abs finish every session. Level II adds reps and Level III brings harder moves.
